        if ':' in line:
            key, val = line.split(':', 1)
            habits[key.strip()] = val.strip().lower()
    parsed.append({'date': date, 'habits': habits})

# Check habit order from first note
first_habits = list(parsed[0]['habits'].keys())
print("Habit order from first note:", first_habits)
# Check all notes have same keys in same order
for p in parsed:
    if list(p['habits'].keys()) != first_habits:
        print("Mismatch in", p['date'], list(p['habits'].keys()))
        break
else:
    print("All notes have same habit order.")
